item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 16/Jun/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The active southwesterly airstream will continue to bring heavy showers and thunderstorms to the coast of southern China tomorrow. With an anticyclone aloft strengthening gradually, the weather will improve and it will be hot over Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week. Meanwhile, under the influence of a southerly airstream, there will still be a few showers over the region.

Date/Month: 17/06 (Tuesday)
Wind: South to southwest force 3 to 4, force 5 on high ground at first.
Weather: Cloudy with occasional showers and squally thunderstorms. Showers will be heavy at times.
Temp range: 27 - 30 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
